scientific_checks: Table3 is20 model-based plug-in score reliabilities from five separate one-factor models, not alpha or fit indices.
Source says sigma reliability exceeds standardized and congeneric reliabilities for all5 traits, and standardized exceeds congeneric except extraversion.

Original code example.R uses raw bfi items with default lavaan::cfa and transforms loadings by sqrt(psi). Reliability code uses abs(lambda), aligning item signs. Literal raw mixed-sign sum scores are not the target.
Reliability reproduction does not establish model fit or construct validity.
Table3 is a bounded selected empirical finding, not the entire thesis headline or proof of universal advice against standardized/ordinal alpha.
